findings: In `extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective-plan.ts`, `readSessionSnapshot` validates snapshot records and ancestry and checks for pending tool calls before conversion; `validateCompleteToolCalls` rejects unfinished tool-call batches.

In `extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts`, `completeRewind` writes `branch:<newLabel>` to the summary entry before calling `branchWithSummary`; if branching fails, its catch path restores the prior leaf and removes that completion label.
